types.name: Liquid / short-term debt
facts: Suits people parking money they may need within weeks or months, like an emergency cushion.
Minimum time to stay invested in this demo: about 1 month; short-term debt versions suit 6 months or more.
No lock-in.
Exit charge: none for liquid funds in this demo; up to 0.25% for short-term debt if you leave within a year.
Yearly costs are low, around 0.2-0.35% of your money in this demo.
Risk is low. In a bad period, a fund like this could dip 1-2% in the demo scenario and usually recover within weeks to a few months.
Tax basics: gains are added to your income and taxed at your slab rate. Check current rules before investing.
You can withdraw anytime, and money usually reaches your bank in 1 working day. Past behaviour does not predict the future.

types.name: Hybrid
facts: Suits people who want a middle path between safer loans and company shares for 1-3 years or more.
Minimum time to stay invested in this demo: 1-2 years depending on the mix.
No lock-in.
Exit charge: 0.5-1% if you leave within a year in this demo.
Yearly costs are moderate, around 0.55-0.7% of your money in this demo.
Risk is low to medium. In a severe crash, a fund like this could fall 15-25% in the demo scenario, and recovery could take about a year.
Tax basics: depends on how much is in shares; share-heavy funds are taxed like equity. Check current rules.
You can withdraw anytime, and money usually reaches your bank in 2-3 working days. Past behaviour does not predict the future.

types.name: Index fund
facts: Suits people who can stay invested for 5 years or more.
It follows a market index, so it rises and falls with the market.
In a severe crash, a fund like this could fall 30-40% in the demo scenario, and recovery could take a couple of years.
No lock-in. Exit charge: none to 0.5% in this demo.
Costs are low compared with actively managed funds, around 0.15-0.3% a year in this demo.
Tax basics: taxed like equity; gains after 1 year are taxed at a lower rate than short-term gains. Check current rules.
You can withdraw anytime, and the money usually reaches your bank in 1-3 working days. Not suited to money you need within 3 years.
Past behaviour does not predict the future.

types.name: Flexi-cap equity
facts: Suits patient people who can stay invested for 5 years or more and handle big swings.
A manager picks shares of small, mid and large companies.
In a severe crash, a fund like this could fall 35-45% in the demo scenario, and recovery could take 2-3 years.
No lock-in. Exit charge: 1% if you leave within a year in this demo.
Costs are higher than index funds, around 0.8-1% a year in this demo, because people choose the shares.
Tax basics: taxed like equity; holding over 1 year is taxed at a lower rate. Check current rules.
You can withdraw anytime, and money usually reaches your bank in 1-3 working days. Not for money needed within 5 years.
Past behaviour does not predict the future.

types.name: ELSS
facts: Suits people who want to lower income tax under the old tax rules and can wait at least 3 years.
Lock-in: 3 years. Each monthly instalment is locked for its own 3 years.
You cannot withdraw during the lock-in, even in an emergency.
Exit charge: none after the lock-in in this demo.
Costs are around 0.7-0.9% a year in this demo.
Risk is high. In a severe crash, a fund like this could fall 35-45% in the demo scenario, and recovery could take 2-3 years.
Tax basics: investment may be deductible under old rules; gains are taxed like equity. Check current rules.
After the lock-in, money usually reaches your bank in 1-3 working days. Past behaviour does not predict the future.

types.name: Gold fund
facts: Suits people who want some gold in their savings without storing physical gold, for 3 years or more.
Its price follows gold, which depends on world markets and the rupee.
In a bad period, a fund like this could fall 15-20% in the demo scenario and stay flat for several years.
No lock-in. Exit charge: 0.5-1% if you leave within a year in this demo.
Costs are around 0.4-0.55% a year in this demo.
Risk is medium. Gold often moves differently from shares.
Tax basics: gains are taxed under rules for non-equity funds. Check current rules.
You can withdraw anytime, and money usually reaches your bank in 2-3 working days. Past behaviour does not predict the future.
